title: Andar + Gerund: Going Around Doing
goal: Say that someone is going around doing something, here and there, with andar and a gerund.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can say that someone is going around doing something, here and there, with andar and a gerund.
I can tell andar + gerund from ir + gerund.
I can use the new words for gossip and moving house.
